entities.summary: Ryan Patrick O'Hearn is an American professional baseball first baseman and designated hitter for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Kansas City Royals, Baltimore Orioles, and San Diego Padres. O'Hearn was an All-Star in 2025.
